d: Manage governance, risk management, and compliance activities across construction programs and projects to ensure adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and industry best practices.

Support the establishment and maintenance of effective governance frameworks, risk controls, compliance monitoring processes, and assurance activities that promote project integrity, transparency, and operational excellence.
Drive proactive risk identification, compliance oversight, and governance reporting to support successful project delivery and organizational objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Risk Management, Law, Finance, or a related field.
PMP, PMI-RMP, CRMP, CIA, CISA, ISO 31000, or equivalent professional certification preferred.
6–10 years of progressive experience in governance, risk management, compliance, construction controls, audit, project management, or related disciplines.
Supporting governance and compliance activities within large-scale construction, infrastructure, real estate, or capital project environments.
Conducting risk assessments, compliance reviews, and assurance activities.
Developing governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and control mechanisms.
Working with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, consultants, and regulatory stakeholders.
Preparing governance reporting, risk analysis, and executive-level presentations.
r: Implement and maintain construction governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks across assigned projects and programs.
Monitor compliance with organizational policies, governance requirements, regulatory obligations, and project controls standards.
Facilitate risk identification, assessment, mitigation planning, and risk monitoring activities across construction portfolios.
Conduct governance reviews, compliance assessments, audits, and assurance activities to evaluate adherence to established requirements.
Track and report governance, compliance, and risk management performance indicators and key metrics.
Support the development and implementation of risk registers, control frameworks, compliance plans, and governance procedures.
Coordinate corrective actions, mitigation plans, and continuous improvement initiatives arising from audit findings or compliance reviews.
Collaborate with Project Delivery, Commercial, Procurement, Legal, Finance, Internal Audit, and Risk functions to address governance and compliance matters.
Review project governance documentation, approvals, delegations, and decision-making processes to ensure compliance with established requirements.
Support regulatory engagement activities and facilitate responses to governance, compliance, and risk-related inquiries.
Prepare governance reports, executive dashboards, risk summaries, and committee presentations.
Promote risk awareness, compliance culture, and governance best practices across project teams and stakeholders.

d: The Lean Store team owns some of Lean's most revenue-critical and compliance-sensitive infrastructure — from payouts and billing to the regulatory ledger underpinning ADGM and SwiftX growth. As a Senior Software Engineer on this squad, you'll take full ownership of core systems, drive delivery on committed integrations, and ensure the reliability of infrastructure that processes millions in transactions. This is a hands-on execution role for an engineer who thrives on owning domains end-to-end.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 350+ clients — from Binance and Careem to Etisalat — and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: Strong backend engineering in Java, Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, microservices, and REST APIs
Production experience with Kafka for event-driven systems
Data layer proficiency: PostgreSQL and Redis
Familiarity with build and delivery tooling: Maven, Docker, Jenkins
Observability mindset: Prometheus and Grafana in production environments
Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling (e.g. Claude) in day-to-day work
Ability to own a domain independently — handle most backlog items without direction, drive design decisions, and contribute to tech specs
Writes high-quality, secure, fully tested code with solid monitoring and alerting
Clear communicator — able to explain technical risk to both engineers and leadership
Reliable on commitments; unblocks the squad and escalates early when needed
Experience working within regulated financial environments

NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!
r: Build and maintain core ledger functionality that underpins Lean's SwiftX compliance use case and regulatory requirements for ADGM scaling
Own the billing system end-to-end — its reliability, maintenance, and ongoing evolution
Deliver on the Mal integration, a strategically committed new integration with direct revenue implications
Cover ongoing payouts infrastructure — incident response, client features, and DC-related work — ensuring SLA adherence on a live revenue stream
Drive stability, performance, and scalability improvements proactively across the squad's domain
Give design-level code reviews, contribute to refinement, and write clear technical specifications
x: We’re building the financial infrastructure for MENA. Not as a slogan, as a fact.

Since 2019, we’ve become the first regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We’ve processed billions of dollars. We connect millions of accounts. We enable companies like Binance, Careem, and Etisalat to build products that were previously impossible in this region.

Our recent $67.5M Series B from General Catalyst and Sequoia isn’t just validation: it’s fuel. We’re expanding into new markets, launching new products, and setting the pace for what financial innovation looks like in MENA.
We solve hard problems. We move fast. We hold ourselves to a high standard. And we’re looking for people who’ve done this before to help us do it right.
If you’re motivated by building something that lasts, not just something that scales, Lean is where you need to be.

Not only do we offer competitive salaries, private healthcare, and flexible office hours, but we also insist that every member of the team hold a meaningful equity stake in the business to ensure long-term alignment. We'd love you to join us for this journey!
